regions.today: Today will be cool and blustery with sunny spells and scattered showers, heavy at times. Highest temperatures of 9 to 12 degrees with a moderate to fresh and gusty southwest to west wind.
regions.tonight: Tonight will start dry with clear spells but it’ll become cloudy with outbreaks of rain overnight. The rain will clear to scattered showers by morning. Breezy with a moderate to fresh and gusty southwesterly wind and lowest temperatures of 6 to 10 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow morning will be mostly cloudy with scattered showers. From late morning onwards it’ll be largely dry with just isolated showers and some sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 13 to 15 degrees with moderate to fresh southwesterly winds in the morning, decreasing light to moderate and becoming southerly later.
